headline: Phishing attacks: Fraudsters hijack Booking.com partners and seize 80,000 euros
summary: Prime Minister Luís Montenegro said the current price situation could be prolonged. Unlike other European countries, Portugal will not reduce its consumption tax under the government plan.
why: Consumption taxes such as VAT feed directly into consumer prices and inflation, so changes to them affect household spending and the outlook for central bank policy.
